override.title: Admin Ku tlula nawu
override.hint: Ti overrides ti tshama ti logged na admin identity ya wena na xivangelo - never silent.
override.cancelBookingHint: Ku khansela swi fungha ku bukuta na khomixini ya kona tanihi leswi khanseleriweke, swi tlherisela vun’wini bya ntirho eka mutirhisani, naswona swi tshika muaki a bukuta vukorhokeri lebyi nakambe.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Khansela ku bukuta loku? Khomixini ya yona na yona yi khanseliwile. Leswi swi logged na vito ra wena na xivangelo.

detail.disputeOpen: Mpfilumpfilu wa vun’wini wu pfulekile eka muxavi loyi - mutirhisani un’wana u vula leswaku i wa vona. Yi tekiwa xiboho eka tluka ra Minkanerisano.

cancellation.title: Ku bukuta ku khanseliwile
cancellation.hint: Ku bukuta na khomixini ya kona swi khanseriwa; vun’wini bya matirhelo byi vuyile na mutirhisani naswona muaki a nga bukuta lead leyi nakambe.

disputes.title: Minkanerisano ya Vun’wini
disputes.hint: Mutirhisani loyi ku tsarisiwa ka yena ku ariweke tanihi ku phindha-phindha a nga kanetana leswaku i n’wini wa muxavi. Pfuxeta matlhelo hamambirhi kutani u endla xiboho.
disputes.empty: Ku hava minjhekanjhekisano na xiyimo lexi.
